sentences.content: What is the highest mountain in the world?

sentences.content: Qomolangma.
sentences.english: Qomolangma
sentences.chinese: Qomolangma

sentences.content: Yesterday, we learned some important geographical facts.

sentences.content: I hope you all still remember them.

sentences.chinese: 现在我要问你几个问题来测试一下。

sentences.content: Qomolangma! It’s higher than any other mountain in the world.
sentences.english: Qomolangma ! It's higher than any other mountain in the world
sentences.chinese: 珠穆朗玛峰！它是世界上最高的山峰。

sentences.content: That’s right.
sentences.english: That's right
sentences.chinese: 没错。

sentences.content: And who can tell me what the Sahara is?
sentences.english: And who can tell me what the Sahara is ?
sentences.chinese: 那么谁能告诉我撒哈拉是什么？

sentences.content: The Sahara is the biggest desert in the world.
sentences.english: The Sahara is the biggest desert in the world
sentences.chinese: 撒哈拉是世界上最大的沙漠。

sentences.content: You’re all so smart!
sentences.english: You're all so smart !
sentences.chinese: 你们真是太聪明了！

sentences.content: Now, for the last question, which is the longest river in the world?

sentences.content: I know! The Nile is the longest river in the world.

sentences.content: Hi, I’m Mike. I’m from the United States.
sentences.english: Hi , I'm Mike . I'm from the United States
sentences.chinese: 你好，我是Mike。我来自美国。

sentences.content: Welcome to our class, Mike. We’re happy to meet you.
sentences.english: Welcome to our class , Mike . We're happy to meet you
sentences.chinese: 欢迎来到我们班，Mike。很高兴认识你。

sentences.content: Can you tell me a bit more about China?
sentences.english: Can you tell me a bit more about China ?
sentences.chinese: 你能多告诉我一些关于中国的事情吗？

sentences.content: Sure! Did you know that China is one of the oldest countries in the world?
sentences.english: Sure ! Did you know that China is one of the oldest countries in the world ?
sentences.chinese: 当然！你知道吗，中国是世界上最古老的国家之一。

sentences.english: Yes , and it's the biggest country in Asia
sentences.chinese: 是的，它是亚洲最大的国家。

sentences.content: We also have some famous rivers. The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia. It’s about 6,300 kilometers long.
sentences.english: We also have some famous rivers . The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia . It's about 6 ,300 kilometers long

sentences.content: Wow! I didn’t know that. I thought the Yellow River was longer.
sentences.english: Wow ! I didn't know that . I thought the Yellow River was longer
sentences.chinese: 哇！我还真不知道。我以为黄河会更长一些呢。

sentences.content: No, the Yellow River is 5,464 kilometers long. But both rivers are very important to China.

sentences.chinese: 不，黄河全长5464公里。但这两条河流对中国都非常重要。

sentences.content: How long is the wall?
sentences.english: How long is the wall ?
sentences.chinese: 这堵墙有多长？

sentences.content: Ah, the most popular question!
sentences.english: Ah , the most popular question !
sentences.chinese: 啊，这个最常见的问题！

sentences.content: If we’re only talking about the parts from the Ming Dynasty,

sentences.content: Wow, that’s amazing! Why did the ancient emperors build the wall?

sentences.chinese: 哇，这太不可思议了！古代的帝王们为什么要修建长城呢？

sentences.content: One of the world’s most dangerous sports is mountain climbing, and one of the most popular places for this is the Himalayas.

sentences.content: Thick clouds cover the top and snow can fall very hard.

sentences.content: It is also very hard to take in air as you get near the top.

sentences.chinese: 当你接近山顶时，呼吸也会变得异常困难。

sentences.content: The first people to reach the top were Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary on May 29, 1953.
